name: Billie Bust Up
detailed_description:
Billie Bust Up is a captivating 3D platformer that blends music, magic, and adventure in a world inspired by your favorite animated classics. Join Billie, a daring young goat, on a quest to uncover her father’s legacy and reclaim a powerful magic. With her mystical axolotl mentor Aristotle and loyal pet fox Oscar, you'll explore vibrant, whimsical realms, face off against quirky, song-slinging villains, and master incredible magical abilities.

Dive into rhythm-based combat where every move is synced to the beat! Guide Billie through vibrant, music-driven battles, where timing is crucial to defeat quirky enemies and push the story forward. As you progress, Billie uncovers a dark mystery, all while the game weaves catchy tunes and emotional storytelling to keep you hooked. It’s an immersive experience that blends rhythm, action, and heart.

Music is at the heart of your musical odyssey. Each boss and character has their own signature track, and the music shapes the gameplay, making every battle feel like a dynamic, interactive performance. As you play, the rhythm-driven mechanics and vibrant tunes pull you deeper into the story. You are a part of the music itself, driving the narrative forward with every beat.

Key Features:

  • Move to the Music: Engage in rhythm-based battles where your attacks sync to the beat, and music adapts to your play style, creating dynamic, ever-changing gameplay experiences.

  • An Enchanting Ensemble: Team up with a quirky cast of heroes and villains, each with their own unique personalities and backstories, in a whimsical, adventurous tale.

  • For the Young at Heart: Inspired by animated classics, Billie Bust Up blends fantasy, humor, and heartfelt moments with a story of friendship, family, and hidden secrets.

  • Showstopping Songs: Experience character-driven songs composed by Daniel Ingram, with an optional sing-along mode to bring out your inner performer.

  • Embrace The Magic: Use a variety of magical abilities, from gliding with an umbrella wand to freezing enemies, solving puzzles, and vanishing into invisibility.

short_description: Embark on a thrilling and imaginative odyssey in a 3D platforming musical inspired by your favorite timeless, magical animated films. Meet a fantastical cast of characters, take gameplay cues from the music—and try not to let the villains’ songs get stuck in your head.

*languages with full audio support

  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050, AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
